Update one or more text style parameters in a single command.
Fields are routed to their underlying handlers and merged into one patch.
Pass a comma-separated --seg-id (e.g. id1,id2,id3) to restyle multiple text
segments at once.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --seg-id <SEG_ID[,SEG_ID...]> ... 
                              Target segment id; repeat --seg-id or pass a comma-separated list
          --seg-type <TYPE[,TYPE...]> 
                              Target segment type; must match this typed shortcut
          --target-track <INDEX[,INDEX...]> 
                              Target track index(es)
          --seg-index <INDEX[,INDEX...]> 
                              Comma-separated segment indexes within one target track, e.g.
                              0,2,-1
          --time-window <START,END> 
                              Select segments overlapping the half-open timeline window
                              [start,end); start must be less than end
          --size TEXT         Font size number, e.g. 64 (numeric only, not a string). Unitless
                              scalar.
          --color TEXT        Text color, hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB, e.g. #FF0000 / 0xFF0000
          --alpha TEXT        Text alpha with normalized scalar or percent. Use a bare scalar
                              or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0,1].
          --outline-color TEXT 
                              Text outline color, hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB, e.g. #000000
          --outline-width TEXT 
                              Text outline width, e.g. 0.08. Unitless scalar.
          --font TEXT         Font resource id / name
          --bold TEXT         Bold (true/false)
          --italic TEXT       Italic (true/false)
          --underline TEXT    Underline (true/false)
          --shadow TEXT       Enable shadow (true/false)
          --shadow-color TEXT Shadow color, hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB, e.g. #000000
          --shadow-alpha TEXT Shadow alpha with normalized scalar or percent. Use a bare scalar
                              or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0,1].
          --shadow-angle TEXT Shadow angle in [-180,180]. Canonical unit: deg; the deg suffix
                              is preferred and bare degree values remain accepted. Range after
                              normalization: [-180,180].
          --shadow-distance TEXT 
                              Shadow distance in [0,100]. Unitless scalar. Range after
                              normalization: [0,100].
          --shadow-diffuse TEXT 
                              Shadow diffuse in [0,0.1666]. Unitless scalar. Range after
                              normalization: [0,0.16666667163372].
          --shadow-smoothing TEXT 
                              Shadow smoothing. Unitless scalar.
          --curve TEXT        Enable text curve (true/false)
          --curve-angle TEXT  Text curve angle in [-360,360]. Canonical unit: deg; the deg
                              suffix is preferred and bare degree values remain accepted. Range
                              after normalization: [-360,360].
          --alignment TEXT    Text alignment (integer). Unitless whole-number index.
          --typesetting TEXT  Text typesetting (integer). Unitless whole-number index.
          --letter-spacing TEXT 
                              Letter spacing in [-0.5,5]. Unitless scalar. Range after
                              normalization: [-0.5,5].
          --line-spacing TEXT Line spacing in [-0.5,5]. Unitless scalar. Range after
                              normalization: [-0.5,5].
          --fixed-width TEXT  Fixed width in [-1,1000000]. Canonical unit: px; the px suffix is
                              preferred and bare px values remain accepted. Range after
                              normalization: [-1,1000000]. Whole-number value required.
          --fixed-height TEXT Fixed height in [-1,1000000]. Canonical unit: px; the px suffix
                              is preferred and bare px values remain accepted. Range after
                              normalization: [-1,1000000]. Whole-number value required.
          --background, --no-background{false}   
                              Enable text background; use --no-background to disable it. Does
                              not change background style
          --background-color TEXT 
                              Text background color, hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB
          --background-alpha TEXT 
                              Text background alpha with normalized scalar or percent. Use a
                              bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0,1].
          --background-width TEXT 
                              Text background width scale with normalized scalar or percent.
                              Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range
                              after normalization: [0,1].
          --background-height TEXT 
                              Text background height scale with normalized scalar or percent.
                              Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range
                              after normalization: [0,1].
          --background-radius TEXT 
                              Text background corner radius with normalized scalar or percent.
                              Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range
                              after normalization: [0,1].
          --background-x-offset TEXT 
                              Text background horizontal offset with normalized scalar or
                              percent. Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is
                              invalid. Range after normalization: [-1,1].
          --background-y-offset TEXT 
                              Text background vertical offset with normalized scalar or
                              percent. Use a bare scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is
                              invalid. Range after normalization: [-1,1].
          --background-style TEXT 
                              Text background shape: square|wrap or 1|2; disable with
                              --no-background
          --glow-resource TEXT 
                              Glow resource id (vimo://<id>)
          --glow-color TEXT   Glow color, hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB, e.g. #FFFFFF
          --glow-range TEXT   Glow range with normalized scalar or percent. Use a bare scalar
                              or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0.01,1].
          --glow-strength TEXT 
                              Glow strength with normalized scalar or percent. Use a bare
                              scalar or percent; the ratio suffix is invalid. Range after
                              normalization: [0,1].
          --range TEXT        Rich-text character range <start,end> (UTF-16, half-open); omit
                              for the whole segment
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

EXAMPLES
  # Set several base style fields at once (size / color / bold)
  $ lyra-cli draft text style --seg-id <UUID> --size 64 --color #FF0000 --bold true
  # Restyle multiple text segments in one command (comma-separated --seg-id)
  $ lyra-cli draft text style --seg-id id1,id2,id3 --alpha 80% --color #FFFFFF
  # Add a rounded solid background behind text
  $ lyra-cli draft text style --seg-id <UUID> --background-color #111111 --background-alpha 72% --background-radius 40%
  # Disable text background without changing its square/wrap style setting
  $ lyra-cli draft text style --seg-id <UUID> --no-background
  # Apply a scoped style to a UTF-16 character range only (bold on chars [0,3))
  $ lyra-cli draft text style --seg-id <UUID> --bold true --range 0,3
NOTE: pass at least one style field besides --seg-id (e.g. --size / --color / --bold / ...); --seg-id alone produces no change.
NOTE: color fields (--color / --outline-color / --shadow-color / --background-color / --glow-color) accept hex #RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBB (e.g. #FF0000 or 0xFF0000); numeric fields must follow each option's unit help (for example --size 64, --alpha 80%, and --fixed-width 320px).
NOTE: --background-style only accepts square|wrap or 1|2; use --no-background to disable the background.
NOTE: --range <start,end> restricts scoped styles (shadow/bold/italic/underline/rich-style) to a UTF-16 character range; omit for the whole segment.
